notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Dragon.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boneyard Scourge, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another Dragon, adding {B}.
When the Dragon dies, Boneyard Scourge triggers, causing you to pay {1}{B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Boneyard Scourge enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
Repeat.
